# FIT fixtures

All the files are generated, with a fixed seed and invented dates (March 2026,
manufacturer `development`, fictitious serial numbers). They are regenerated from the
repository root with:

    python -m tests.fixtures.generators.make_fixtures

Run again, it produces the same bytes. The scripts use only the standard library.
The activity history for the tests (`generators/history.py`,
`generate_history(out_dir, days, seed, start_date)`) is not versioned: the
tests write it in a temporary folder.

## `fit/` (script: `generators/make_fixtures.py`)

| File | What it exercises |
|---|---|
| `run_constant_160.fit` | Run of exactly 60' at 160 bpm, without noise: T-CALC-01 (hand-computed values) |
| `copy_of_run_constant_160.fit` | Same bytes and same `file_id` as the previous one, different name: duplicate for T-IMP |
| `run_intervals.fit` | Run with warm-up, 6 x (3' hard, 2' recovery), drift and cool-down |
| `bike_easy.fit` | Easy 55' bike ride with slight cardiac drift |
| `strength_low_hr.fit` | Strength (`sport` training, `sub_sport` strength_training), low HR |
| `walk_no_hr.fit` | Walk without HR (all `heart_rate` = 0xFF): marked estimate, T-CALC-06 |
| `run_hr_gaps.fit` | Run with 12 s of invalid HR and 15 s without records: gaps over 10 s, T-CALC-07 |
| `run_hr_out_of_range.fit` | Run with samples at 0 and 250 bpm: samples discarded and counted, T-CALC-03 |
| `run_one_second.fit` | 1 s activity (a single record): T-CALC-07 |
| `hike_24h.fit` | 24 h hike, one sample every 5 s: maximum duration, T-CALC-07 |
| `run_gps_loop.fit` | 20' run on a circle of 300 m radius at 3 m/s, with positions, altitude, session distance (3597 m) and elevation gain (60 m), declared start: summary, simplified track and polyline |
| `bike_indoor_no_gps.fit` | 30' indoor bike ride (`sub_sport` indoor_cycling) without positions: distance from the sensor (14392 m), no elevation gain nor track |
| `run_gps_invalid_positions.fit` | Run on a straight line eastwards with invalid positions (0x7FFFFFFF) in the first 30 records and in 10 in the middle; the session does not declare the start: the first valid record counts |

The three fixtures with positions (generated by `build_gps`, with their own seed) use
invented coordinates in the open sea, around 30° S 20° W, far from any
inhabited place. The ones above have no positions or distance and their bytes never
change: `tests/fixtures/test_fixture_hashes.py` checks their SHA-256.

## `fit-ostili/` (script: `generators/make_fixtures.py`, derived from a valid 5-sample FIT)

All of them must be rejected by the reader with an error, never with a crash or
a huge allocation (T-SEC, T-IMP-01). Exception: `empty.fit` is not an error
for `fitdecode` (zero messages), but the app must discard it.

| File | What it exercises |
|---|---|
| `header_size_too_large.fit` | Header declares 1000 more bytes of data than the real amount |
| `header_size_too_small.fit` | Declared size 10, real data longer |
| `header_size_max_uint32.fit` | Declared size 0xFFFFFFFF |
| `header_size_huge.fit` | Declared size ~4 GiB, 22-byte file |
| `truncated_in_header.fit` | 9-byte file, incomplete header |
| `truncated_mid_record.fit` | Truncated in the middle of a message |
| `truncated_no_crc.fit` | Final CRC missing |
| `bad_file_crc.fit` | Wrong final CRC |
| `bad_header_crc.fit` | Wrong header CRC |
| `bad_signature.fit` | Signature `.FIX` instead of `.FIT` |
| `undefined_local_message.fit` | Data message without a definition |
| `huge_field_definition.fit` | Definition with 255 fields of 255 bytes and truncated data |
| `empty.fit` | Empty file (0 bytes) |
